column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2233's live-interleaving race test for sendWebhook has a postgres subtest and an mssql_rcsi_on subtest that forces READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT on in a private database (notificationsPrivateRCSIDatabase), built only when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set. ci.yml's test-go/plugins job provides only PostgreSQL (CLEAT_TEST_DB), so the mssql_rcsi_on subtest skips there while postgres runs. Measured by name: go test ./plugins/notifications/... -run TestASendWebhookRacingAnOpenDeleteTransactionIsBlocked -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset reports exactly this one skip.
